name: alita-robot
description: Telegram group management bot built with Go

REDIS_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for REDIS_URL. Heroku Redis uses a self-signed certificate, so the bot cannot connect without this.

PANEL_ENABLED.description: Serve the optional Telegram Mini App admin panel under /panel and add its buttons to the bot.

PANEL_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL Telegram opens for the panel, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com/panel. Required when PANEL_ENABLED is true.

PANEL_MINIAPP_SHORTNAME.description: Optional BotFather Mini App short name; when set, group buttons open the panel directly.
